value.rationale: The 2026 primary paper asks about topology of modulus-root cluster sets, proving connectedness in the bounded-below regime and a single disconnectedness example otherwise. Exact realization and classification of countably many clopen copies of an arbitrary compact amplitude space is a natural qualitative strengthening: a Cantor choice yields uncountably many components while every scalar asymptotic numerical range remains an identical interval. This isolates information lost by scalar numerical-range invariants. The statement is not a finite numerical gain or cosmetic rescaling of a known fixed-parameter example, though older sparse-shift literature remains a priority risk.
